documents.subject: Payroll record clarification request
documents.body:
Hello Casey Team05,

For the 2025-12-31 payroll record PAY-012, the packet lists gross wages of $438,000.00, withholding of $87,600.00, employer amounts of $35,040.00, and net wages of $350,400.00. Please provide any missing explanation needed to support reconciliation of these fields and identify whether any related external movement has been confirmed. Under the settlement policy for MERIDIAN-001, only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. No additional approval or payment is established by this draft. Please advise on the appropriate next review step.

Regards,
Taylor Team06

documents.subject: Settlement policy excerpt
documents.body: Settlement policy applicable to MERIDIAN-001: Only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. This excerpt is provided for review of payroll record PAY-012 dated 2025-12-31. The policy does not, by itself, establish that an external movement occurred, that a proposal was approved, or that a payment was made. Any operational treatment should remain conditional until the record contains the required confirmation. Missing explanations should be requested from the relevant owner, and no transaction purpose should be inferred from the payroll fields alone.

documents.subject: Open question for PAY-012
documents.body: For payroll record PAY-012 dated 2025-12-31, what supporting explanation should be attached to the listed gross, withholding, employer, and net fields? Specifically, can the responsible owner identify whether any external movement connected with this record is confirmed, or whether the item remains only a proposal? The settlement policy for MERIDIAN-001 states that proposals are not settlements. Please also clarify whether any additional approval or payment exists in the record. If the packet does not establish these points, reconciliation should remain unresolved and the missing information should be requested.

documents.subject: Next steps for payroll review
documents.body: Following the review of PAY-012 on 2025-12-31, please send the missing explanation for the payroll fields and any available indication of a confirmed external movement. Casey Team05 should confirm the appropriate finance review path, while Taylor Team06 can coordinate the information request as needed. Until confirmation is provided, do not treat a proposal as a settlement under the policy for MERIDIAN-001. This follow-up does not record an approval, payment, or resolved reconciliation result. The item should remain pending clarification, with purpose and outcome left unstated unless supported by the packet.
